title: MOFA reiterates that the ROC (Taiwan) enjoys right to equal participation in APEC; calls on China to uphold its commitments as 2026 host economy
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs calls on China to halt its political machinations and carry out its duties as Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum host economy by respecting the core principle of equal participation of all member economies in accordance with APEC guidelines, norms, and practices and by taking concrete steps to ensure Taiwan’s right to equal and dignified participation in the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China in November.

Taiwan became a full member of APEC in 1991. The text of the memorandum of understanding on Taiwan’s accession did not mention a “one China principle.” However, it did clearly state that Taiwan would participate in APEC meetings and activities on an equal basis with other member economies.

Additionally, all APEC member states—including China—supported the inclusion of the following language in the 2024 and 2025 joint statements of the APEC Ministerial Meetings: “We attach great importance to APEC’s continued cooperation in the spirit of multilateralism on the basis of consensus with all members participating on an equal footing in all its events including Leaders’ Week, in accordance with the Guidelines for Hosting APEC Meetings and relevant APEC conventions.” Furthermore, in 2024, China provided explicit written assurance concerning the safety of all participants from member economies and their smooth entry into and exit from China for APEC meetings. China is obliged to fulfill its commitments and adhere to consensus decisions made by all member economies. (E)
